title: Edge of the Periodic Table: three open-data experiments
description:
Three questions about the far end of the periodic table, answered with published open data and fully reproducible code: (1) rebuilding the periodic table from the Madelung rule and, separately, from ionization energies alone; (2) a liquid-drop + Gaussian-process model of superheavy nuclei that uses measured alpha-decay energies as mass-difference constraints and forecasts the half-lives of elements 119 and 120 (about 1–5 ms and 0.06–0.4 ms, alpha decay dominant) with honest, tested uncertainties; (3) an anomaly search and r-process correlations in JINAbase metal-poor stars, including a partial check of the fission-fragment signature of nuclei heavier than uranium.

Use of AI: the analysis, code and text were produced with Claude (Anthropic) under the direction of the author, who is responsible for the content. Exploratory work, not peer-reviewed.
